summary.text: Troy Gargiulo is the Republican and Independent Party of Connecticut candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 120 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Kaitlyn Shake.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Stratford resident who works in HVAC.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Gargiulo said he lives in Stratford with his wife and their two children and takes part in volunteer efforts through Stratford Baptist Church.
He listed his priorities as affordability, energy costs, the economy and job retention, education, public safety, and housing and development.

He also said Stratford should keep the ability to shape its own zoning and development policy, and called Connecticut's 8-30g affordable housing framework an inadequate response to housing and neighborhood development concerns.
